notes.title: Cooking Simulator Shelter and Cakes and Cookies DLCs out now on PlayStation 🎮
notes.notes:

Today we have some great news for those of you who enjoy cooking on consoles 🎮[/p][p][/p][p]Shelter and Cakes and Cookies DLCs are out today on PlayStation![/p][p]The expansions will be [b]available at 4PM your local time[/b] :)[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Nc5kW7SMkGQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p]A culinary adventure in a post-apocalyptic world! Big Cheese Studio[/p]

notes.title: ⚙️ New update in Cooking Simulator! 🍣👀
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Hello Chefs![/b]👨‍🍳[/h2]

Are you ready for more improvements in Cooking Simulator? 😍

The latest update brings a ton of fixes, enhancements, and improvements that will make your culinary adventures even more exciting! We’re listening to your feedback and continuously working to improve the game. [b]Thank you for your ongoing support![/b] Below, you’ll find the [b]changelog for the current patch:[/b]

[h3][b]Base[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] While crouching and interacting with the cutting board, and laptop, the camera can no longer go above or below the normal position
[*] When picked up, the cutting board now always positions itself upright
[*] Food processor containers can now be served in modern kitchen
[*] Freeze food movement in held container
[*][Community] "Craftsman" achievement is now possible to unlock by completing all other 5* achievements from the base game
[*] [Community] Fixed a bug where contests would not appear with disabled custom menu
[*] [Community] Contest prizes are now properly counted towards "I have them all." achievement
[*] [Community] Fixed "Perfect Taste", "Perfect Technical" and "Perfect Temperature" daily quest conditions
[*] [Community] Fixed recipes' manager filters not filtering recipes properly
[*] [Community] The dish parts can no longer fall under map, while serving
[/list]
[h3][b]Pizza[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The perk selection UI is now more visible in PerkHUB app
[/list]
[h3][b]C&C[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The dough can no longer clip, and disappears upon transferring from one kneading bowl to another container
[*] Pan x kneading bowl camera adjustment
[/list]
[h3][b]Sushi[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] FPS improvement while making tempura mix
[*] The order archives now reset every day
[*] The oil model is no longer sticking out of the frying machine
[*] Wasabi root hitboxes were adjustmented
[*] End day summary in sushi now properly displays expenses
[/list]
[h3][b]Check out what’s new, download the latest update, and cook up something delicious![/b] 🍽️[/h3]

notes.title: Update 6.0.13: Cooking Simulator Winter Update & Sale
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Hi Chefs! 👨‍🍳[/b][/h2]

We hope you're enjoying the holidays! On our end, we've got a special treat for you: our winter update!

This update includes a new feature and many bug fixes, so check out the summary in the image below, or keep reading for the juicy details!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/deaeebd029766919482ee2e99354a88de87a5c2a.jpg[/img]


[h2]Sushi DLC Update: Gotcha Shop[/h2]

The most significant change we've made is introducing the Gotcha Shop in the Sushi DLC! This feature unlocks after you reach the maximum player level (i.e., achieving Black Belt). Here, you can buy points for the Gotcha! App. We hope this will help players unlock all of the recipes in the Sushi DLC and fully experience all that it has to offer.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/473bf14fb30f70ac0d09a68237aaba447e7ca661.png[/img]

[h2]Bug Fixes [/h2]

The fun doesn't stop with the Gotcha Shop though. We've thoroughly seasoned this version of the game with several bug fixes! Keep reading to learn about what's changed:

[h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved Vsync functionality
[*] Added Winter Theme to the main menu background and music
[/list]
[h3][b]Base Game[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] “A winner!” achievement will unlock properly now, only after receiving 1st place in a contest
[*] Fixed score calculation for contest mode
[*] It should now be possible to upgrade recipes with Custom Menu enabled
[*] The following recipes have had their criteria and/or descriptions updated to facilitate obtaining a 5-star rating when cooking them:
[list]   
[*] Fruit Salad
[*] Cowboy Steak with Baked Potato and Broccoli
[*] Grilled Cabbage Burger
[*] Chicken Pumpkin Stew
[*] Chicken Pumpkin Stew with Tomatoes
[*] Orange Pork Stir-Fry
[*] Pork Chops with Fried Egg and Lemon Baked Potatoes
[*] Chunky Gazpacho
[*] Ukrainian Borscht
[*] Pork Chops and Lemon Baked Potatoes
[*] Honey-Mustard Burger with French Fries
[*] Duck Breast with Apples
[*] Currant-Glazed Pork Tenderloin with Red Cabbage and Thyme Dumplings
[*] Ukrainian Borscht with Boiled Egg
[*] Sweet and Sour Pork
[*] Marinated Sweet and Sour Pork
[/list]
[/list]
[h3][b]Sushi DLC[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a gacha points shop app that unlocks after reaching max level in career mode - you can now buy points to unlock remaining recipes (as mentioned previously)
[*] Vege Kanpyo Abo recipe can now be unlocked in Gotcha! App
[*] Fixed a bug that caused icons in the recipes list in Gotcha! App to not display sometimes
[*] Improved customer feedback for served dishes in day end summary
[*] Improved pouring of loose products (e.g., rice)
[*] Dish summary improvements
[*] Tweaks to the pace of progression
[*] Fixed a bug that caused “Recipe unlocked” notifications to show when they should not
[*] Maki should display correct heat treatment for fried mackerel
[*] Inedible items should no longer be destroyed in the process of making tempura
[*] Equalized the rewards for recipes served for special clients and regular clients
[/list]
[h3][b]Pizza DLC[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Zucchini will no longer fall through all surfaces
[*] Improved visibility for hovered buttons in Perk App
[*] Fixed bug where homemade sauce text was not localized properly
[*] Avocado, Bell peppers, and Eggplant spawners should display properly regardless of which DLCs are purchased
[/list]
[h3][b]Cakes & Cookies DLC[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that would sometimes cause a white square to cover half of the phone screen
[/list]
[h3][b]Shelter DLC[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause multiple, various issues that was triggered by entering context at the end of the day
[/list]

[h2]What's a holiday without a gift?[/h2]

Are you still hungry for more? Don't worry, we've got some dessert for you too! To celebrate the holidays, we're offering massive discounts on Cooking Simulator and all of the DLC!
Give the gift of cooking to a friend, or complete your collection and buy any DLC you've been interested in. We hope that everyone enjoys the holidays and the new year!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/3df3364a634a132680aa42b9594c3e9172b2049c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Community Feedback in Action: Join us on Discord[/h2]

After reviewing the results of our recent survey and your feedback, we're prioritizing updates that reflect what matters most to you. Over the next few months, we’ll be focusing on fixing bugs, reworking some core mechanics and adding new content inspired by your suggestions.

Some of these changes are already in development, so stay tuned for more updates. Thank you for taking the time to share your thoughts and we're looking forward to hearing more of your ideas.

If you'd like your voice to be heard or hear the latest news, we encourage you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/y4yQBudhMG]Discord server[/url] to share your feedback, report bugs or get some sneak peeks of what's coming to Cooking Simulator. We've recently refreshed our Discord server to better serve you, and hope to see you there sharing your Cooking Simulator experience with us and the community. Your feedback helps us make Cooking Simulator better for everyone.


[url=https://discord.gg/y4yQBudhMG][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/4c12181ba6b810a3e99e123ca5e7412d5f51a77c.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]Happy Holidays![/h2]

We wish you a joyful holiday season and a fantastic New Year. Thank you for being part of our community—we’re looking forward to an exciting year ahead together!

[h2]From all of us at Big Cheese Studio[/h2]
[h2]Merry Christmas, Happy Holidays, and Happy New Year![/h2]

notes.title: SUSHI BARS: Equipment 🍣🍚🥢
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/60c8f3780dc9039e9d39644bc523d1863dff0961.jpg[/img]

[b]Hi Chefs![/b]👨‍🍳

[b]Thank you[/b] for such a great interest in our new [b]DLC Cooking Simulator: Sushi.[/b]🎉

While we work on giving you the best cooking experience possible [b]we would like to start revealing and sharing some of the game insights with you! [/b]

[i]And we would like to start with some brand new appliances that our team designed especially for this DLC.[/i] They are [b]MUST HAVES[/b] in the [b]Sushi Chef’s kitchen[/b].

[h3][b]NEW KNIVES!🔪[/b] [/h3]
One of the most important kitchen tools in the hands of every sushi master. Their precision blade, exceptional sharpness, balance and durability make them irreplaceable for different tasks such as cutting fish and maki.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/b8da77d838480d975d31897cafa8bd88a26fbf5c.png[/img]
[h3][b]RICE COOKER!🍚[/b] [/h3]
Perfectly cooked rice is fundamental in making any form of sushi and this machine is of real help in the kitchen. You just have to put the right portion of it inside, wait for a little while and then it’s ready. Remember to rinse it first!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/4e614b31f65d8407f1607146d0c3bbe6c067bdb2.png[/img]
[h3][b]SUSHI OKE!🍱[/b] [/h3]
It’s a 1-piece traditional wooden mixing bowl for rice, it serves to absorb moisture from the recently cooked rice and allows it to cool quickly. In our game it’s perfect for preparing rice seasoned with a mixture of rice vinegar, sugar, and salt.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/7c9db7719beb61dfcedf8e73b5c77df9cf31fa77.png[/img]
[h3][b]WASABI GRATER!🥢[/b] [/h3] 
One of our favourites. Use it for serving freshly grated wasabi that will elevate the flavour of any sushi roll you’ll prepare. The grater has a rough surface and by doing an up and down motion you’ll have as much of this ingredient as you need.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/3896c7f3dca940e8de4bf297610fdda629d47aa8.png[/img]
[h3][b]TAMAGOYAKI PAN!🥘[/b][/h3]
With this pan you’ll be able to prepare a Japanese rolled omelet for tamago nigiri and rolls. Your guests will appreciate different sushi variations so be creative and don’t forget about this small but fancy pan!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/f5bbbfff9ef276513502d1b142904c3f410b8c0c.png[/img]
[i]These are the Sushi Chef little helpers that will appear for the first time in the Cooking Simulator games![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/fb7172d5c17e59e3baa0576b22aeddb7f2ce6afd.png[/img]
[h3][b]Remember to follow and add Cooking Simulator: Sushi to your wishlist!👍[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2655000/Cooking_Simulator__Sushi/

[b]Itadakimasu!🦈[/b]

notes.title: Welcome to the history of SUSHI! 📜🍣🥢
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/58b16293603e0d52579ba39d06f2134f96a66e53.jpg[/img]

[b]Hi Chefs!👨‍🍳[/b]

[i]Sushi is more than just a Japanese dish,[/i] it’s a global phenomenon and [b]the most iconic dish in our brand new DLC.[/b] The world can’t seem to get enough of this delicacy. Have you ever discovered its history as rich and layered as its flavours? Let’s take a [b]gastronomic trip back in time[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/eff7e81753263df79e63d44c826722829a2fe527.png[/img]

[i]A bowl of cooked rice is a central part of traditional Japanese meals[/i], but the grain is also processed into several different types of products, like sushi. Contrary to popular belief, sushi didn’t originate in Japan. Its roots can be traced back to Asia, but it wasn’t until it made its way to Japan that it began to evolve into the sushi we know and love today. 🍙🐟

[i]In Japan sushi began to be served in the form of slices of fresh fish over small mounds of vinegared rice. [/i]This quick and convenient form of sushi became an instant hit, especially among busy workers and travelers. Only later various additions were served in the form of mostly raw seafood, nori seaweed, vegetables, mushrooms, as well as Japanese omelette, tofu and sesame seeds as it is happening today. 🍱🦐

[b]Remember that each piece of sushi you’ll prepare in Cooking Simulator: Sushi has a story to tell!🔥 [/b]

[i]If you’re excited, follow and add the game to your wishlist. We’ll be revealing more tasty details soon![/i]

[b]Itadakimasu![/b]👋

notes.title: Poltergeist multiplayer mode available for beta testing!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/b2bea75237b5659f0c8a0a5d3a91506f0a0c83aa.png[/img]

Hi Chefs!

Winter Holiday is just around the corner! To help you celebrate that special time of the year usually spent bonding with each other, we'd like to invite you to check out the [b]beta version[/b] of the Poltergeist Multiplayer mode.

Yes, you've heard that right. Poltergeist is a holiday-themed multiplayer mode for Cooking Simulator. [b]Just keep in mind that it's still in a very early beta stage, so  definitely expect some bugs while messing around with your friends.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/04ae0c51dede2a13c301d0dfdc8e15e203a9f481.jpg[/img]


[h3][b]How to access beta:[/b][/h3]
1. Right-click on 'Cooking Simulator' in your Steam library and go to 'Properties'
2. In the new window left-click ‘BETAS’ from the left side panel
3. Choose ‘poltergeist’ from the drop-down list
4. Close the window and update the game

[b]IMPORTANT:[/b] The beta contains only the Poltergeist game mode! If you want to access the regular Cooking Simulator game modes, you’ll need to opt out from beta. By using the instruction above, choose ‘none’ from the drop-down list.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/82c98d25f0cde99263f53a9f04ccbb471f3a6b53.png[/img]


Poltergeist Multiplayer mode allows for [b]up to 4 players[/b] sharing the Classic kitchen and preparing dishes. You'll see each other as friendly ghosts flying across the kitchen. Due to the game's nature some of the interactions are limited. [b]You can cooperate by exchanging products and ready made-dishes by using the shared space on the table right in the middle of the kitchen.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/d1026a03c52e54288a4e32b0f6152310ba753bf1.jpg[/img]


[h3]Poltergeist offers 2 game modes:[/h3]
[b]Sandbox[/b] - learn and practice your cooking skills with any pressure or scoring
[b]Leaderboards[/b] - work together to prepare the chosen dishes during the given time and earn the highest score possible


If you'd like to share some feedback or find other players to cook with, make sure to join our official discord server:
[url=discord.gg/bigcheesestudio]discord.gg/bigcheesestudio[/url]

Have fun cooking together!

notes.title: Shelter Devlog #6 | Quests and NPCs
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/08743c3450d38bc794dde9b6b1d3429959e8ab9e.png[/img]

Hi Chefs!

This is the final entry in the devlog series. This time we'll focus on the quests, NPCs and camps in the game.

[b]As a reminder Shelter will be available on November 18 with a nice -15% launch discount! [/b]
Add to your wishlist and don't miss the release!

Also, if you've missed previous entries here's a list of all the Shelter devlogs and their topics:[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/641320/view/3028099453374124922]Shelter Devlog #5 | Caravan[/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/641320/view/2897493876291219142]Shelter Devlog #4 | Cooking and recipes[/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/641320/view/2897493876273230741]Shelter Devlog #3 | Hunting and farming[/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/641320/view/5525337937599293089]Shelter Devlog #2 | Underground chambers[/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/641320/view/5525337937581052357]Shelter Devlog #1 | Inspirations and lore[/url]
[/list]

As you might already know in Shelter you'll be playing as a chef looking for their lost family in the wastelands. After arriving at a place known as Sector 12 you stumble upon an abandoned military comm center. The last hope lies in restoring the radio towers and hopefully contacting our loved ones. Unfortunately we won't be able to fix the radios without the help of nearby settlements and that's where our cooking skills come in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/0c706bd2d7c3fa9b41e88753f6263021a154cb34.png[/img]


Throughout the game we'll complete quests for the 4 camps in the Sector and the caravan who will be the first group of people we'll meet. The camps and their inhabitants are quite diversified. Aside from the nomadic merchant group represented by Mila Run, there are the cattle breeders family from MacStump's ranch, mutated miners of Stedler Camp, survivors operating in a steelworks facility in Firepit Plant and finally the remnants from the former military base.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/4b41f11ae70eb52b7bcf414677313ddf3d308b49.png[/img]


Each group has a leader who'll be giving us varios quests which will eventually lead to mutual trust. The caravan will help us deliver and exchange goods required by each settlement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/bdc11c8e2d5e82e77607bd29be115e4d6e6cc767.png[/img]


Quests unlock various rewards such as resources, gun upgrades, new recipes and so on. Completing the final quest for each settlement will grant us the special parts needed for repairing the radio towers. In case we find ourselves in need of some extra cash or other supplies we can take up to 3 additional side-quests each day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/9449d32ea3028a13d416b24b640a9f758dd75f7e.png[/img]


As for the quests themselves, we wanted to introduce new challenges, different from a strict list of orders to complete. A few examples might be delivering enough highly radioactive food for the mutated miners, preparing cow forage with medicines for MacStumps or preparing food rations and killing mutated rats near our shed to help expeditors from the military base crossing nearby.


How do you like the ideas for the new content? Let us know in the comments.

notes.title: Shelter Devlog #5 | Caravan
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/dee1d32fbcac63c32ea40586585b13b77c1b7bf9.png[/img]

Hi Chefs!

Shelter is getting closer to the release and very soon we'll be able to give you an exact date!

In the previous devlogs you've learned about the new ingredients, recipes, gathering resources and the new environment. Despite all those completely new mechanics, Shelter is still first and foremost a cooking game. It's also [b]NOT[/b] an open world game. All the trading, exchanging resources and contacting other settlements is made possible thanks to the caravan travelling across the sector.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/9a085bd202f83f92e8fe67d97d65c05a6c51e14e.png[/img]


The caravan leader Mila Run will be one of the first people we'll encounter in the Sector. She'll be giving you the first quests that will allow you to build mutual trust. Eventually she'll introduce us to the leaders of other settlers who should be able to help us restore the radio towers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/dd7669a0c40a12b001b8cf601790282de861332e.png[/img]


There are 4 different settlements in the Sector but none are not going to help a complete stranger so before asking for any favors we'll need to do something for them. The quests will vary from cooking for a feast to preparing fodder for carnivorous cows. That's where our cooking skills, resourcefulness and shelter's equipment come in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/3dd7d9e455c63f7627c8b62b49d9a963e5e1bdec.png[/img]

By the end of each day in Shelter you'll be visited by the travelling merchants. They'll collect and deliver all the food we've prepared and also exchange products and other supplies necessary for cooking and surviving in the wasteland.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/5ac4cb6a14fb45e29cdfacc9a8f63a4650c614ac.png[/img]


Wastelands can be quite unpredictable and you might find yourself in need of some extra items you haven't bought in advance. In such cases, you can use the radio to contact the caravan and request an express delivery. Just keep in mind that you'll need to pay extra for such a favor!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/dc688aba9af25f100a7c1743a18dfe7b87b774cd.png[/img]

notes.title: Shelter Devlog #4 | Cooking and recipes 🍳☢️
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/5c2cdbc8f0be7e50314b56e004aa1198c2dace17.jpg[/img]

Hi Chefs!

In the previous devlog we surprised some of you with the new mechanics such as hunting and farming. In this entry we'd like to talk a little bit about cooking and recipes, because Shelter is still first and foremost a cooking game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/07cfb0e04d34843c16eebbca15d3b6310f60b375.jpg[/img]


In Shelter you'll need to utilize your cooking skills to earn trust from the surrounding camps in the Sector and with their help try to find your long lost family. Cooking in the post-apocalypse will be based on ~60 unique food products. That includes meat harvested from 3 types of mutants, monster eggs, mutated plants and mushrooms and various pre-war products such as sauces, spices or multiple canned products. We wanted to see the expansion's setting as an opportunity to introduce tasty and exotic-looking foods.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/120e72d9e7cb5edde5ec3841e8aaa0a84f3c5ddb.jpg[/img]


New products also mean completely new recipes. Surviving in the wastelands requires high levels of creativity and making the most out of available resources. Shelter's cookbook will include a total of 45 recipes with varying levels of complexity. On the post-nuclear menu you'll be able to find all kinds of dishes from soups, stews and burgers to completely new dishes based partially on Turkish cuisine. New types of recipes include shashlik, kebabs and vegetables on a stick.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/b54c994e31c6851b78437a3edf9835df53f542e6.jpg[/img]


Shelter will be equipped with various tools and stands you might know already from the base game. That means ovens, griddles, cookers, pots, pans, knives, blenders all reskinned to match the theme of the game. There will be some new utensils as well. First one is the pipette which should make all the drizzling a bit easier and the second one is a huge BBQ grill placed in the middle of the kitchen. The BBQ grill will be used for preparing all the new skewer-based dishes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/fc1f8ccd63392297b1d3da41730ff875ff8d3695.jpg[/img]


Are you hyped for cooking in the post-nuclear wasteland?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/a22ad6f4b03224c403efb5979217dd6fbfeb7e68.jpg[/img]

Hi Chefs!

Shelter release is just around the corner. Below is the latest devlog dedicated to some of the new mechanics - hunting and farming!

As you might already know, Shelter due to its post-apocalyptic setting is all about being resourceful and making the most out of every opportunity and scarce resources. That's why keeping the old mechanics of instantly buying everything we might need for cooking wouldn't make that much sense in the barren wastelands.

The food products can be obtained in one of 3 ways:
[list]
[*] hunting mutants and harvesting their meat 
[*] growing plants in an underground farm 
[*] ordering additional products from the caravan travelling across the Sector
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/3e86d50074c3e06909911bb4291a3c39e23f0460.png[/img]

The main source of protein will be the meat harvested from 3 species of mutants roaming the desert: rats, armadillos and vultures. During the day we can climb to the shed above our shelter and use it as a hunting range. Shooting is definitely a mechanic you wouldn't expect from a Cooking Simulator game but we tried to make it as interesting and engaging as possible. The gun will feature 4 upgrades:
[list]
[*] Scope
[*] Silencer
[*] Magazine
[*] Extended barrel
[/list]
Those can be unlocked by progressing the accessible immediately in Sandbox mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/c80f7099c8167ccbfebf4838f79708389d375d46.png[/img]

Some quests might require us to maintain the mutants' population at a certain level. Killing too many might result in reduced numbers and longer time required to repopulate again. Mutants can be attracted by using makeshift lures which will attract certain types of creatures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/7299be53d10f3e2486dbeee6b9f81303417beba9.png[/img]

Meat is not the only type of food available in the wastelands. As mentioned in one of the previous entries, we wanted to look at the post-apocalyptic setting as an opportunity to introduce intriguing, colorful and vibrant plant-based foods. The following products can be grown in the underground farm:
[list]
[*] Broccoli
[*] Leek
[*] Cactus
[*] Celery
[*] Tomato
[*] Carrot
[*] Blue mushroom
[*] Red mushroom
[*] Green mushroom 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/c74400dd3414a86e91206c6ad5955973bafba0cc.png[/img]

After planting the seeds, watering and using optional boosters there's a 1-day long growing period after which the plants are ready for harvest. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/2ea3b6cb499af425977e7dc0685f3b0639a5d6c9.png[/img]

Unfortunately one of the side effects of living in an irradiated wasteland are random mutations which can turn our seeds into carnivorous plants. In such a case, the only thing left to do is grabbing our gun to clear the spot for future plants.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/f326825a19e8840b0a043f49bac3a894d11288a3.png[/img]

There are a lot of recipes to master and most of them require more products than can be obtained on our own. The initial supplies can be restocked with the help of the caravan travelling across the Sector.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/ffccd3ab6ac1107a10f7d326b2b6f0c4777f8a52.png[/img]

notes.title: Shelter Devlog #1 | Inspirations and lore ☢️
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/f01ead2b9a811b15ac585fbc9ed2259cc84a48e3.png[/img]

Hi Chefs!

As promised, here's the first entry in the series of posts describing in detail the process of creating this post-nuclear expansion. We'll start off by giving you some insight on the inspirations for the DLC.

When coming up with ideas for new content after Pizza, we quickly decided that we wanted to try a more unusual approach to cooking. Post-apocalyptic setting provided a great opportunity for introducing uncanny mutated food products prepared using unconventional culinary solutions and an environment you wouldn’t normally expect in a cooking game. Obviously, in such a world, a skilled cook able to provide good quality nutritious food would always be in high demand. Plus, a post-apocalypse is simply an awesome setting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/fe0b96a3dfefb826814e7658b5852c72199c5206.png[/img]


After initial research focused on various great movies, books and games we created the first concept arts. The vast desert wastelands of Mad Max had the biggest influence on the new environment. The teal and orange color palette of scorched soil and blue skies above were the look we started to aim for with the surface world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/ac41156cebcd70592d7ea0dddfd20b379d8b5e9b.png[/img]


Mushroom farm concept served as an inspiration for various edible plants created by the radiation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/288bd7c31a7448c2a9d9ea3ecb5f4a998c90dde0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/87e61f46483c8e7a620dc3f6633d043064c32d1e.png[/img]


The expansion is called Shelter for a reason. When it comes to underground bunkers, the biggest influence comes, obviously, from the Fallout (and less obviously from real-life submarine interiors). Unlike the Fallout Vaults though, we wanted our shelter to be equipped with various cooking utensils. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/7dab7196bb4a55120832098ec709a42672abf054.png[/img]


That’s why we focused on repurposing different everyday items from the late 1980s to be used for cooking roughly 46 years after the nuclear apocalypse. Metro 2033 is a great example of a franchise with interesting designs, where people tinker with mundane items to survive in the Moscow metro 20 years after the war that put their world to an end.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/3dd75cc236659c6dbba7f48f8edcb3d7e0339f60.png[/img]


Initially we had 2 ideas for the basic plot and story in the game. In the first one you’d be a member of an underground shelter cooking for a community gathered inside before the bombs fell until the outside world is safe to live again. The second idea, the one we finally took on, was being a skilled cook living in the wastelands looking for their lost family. This plot allowed for introducing more interactions with other settlements, resulting in more diverse quests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/002b151a352b9c185106e5270a4049a90c3bbc84.png[/img]


In the next Devlog we’ll have a deeper look at some of the new mechanics such as hunting and growing food. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Important patch with Custom Menus and multiple bug fixes available!✅
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/80f3037cc38203fa308ef899102ffddb1fda5ebb.png[/img]

Hi Chefs!
We're super excited to finally release the highly anticipated update for Cooking Simulator enabling custom menus and adding [b]a ton[/b] of various bug fixes and improvements.


👀 [b]PLEASE READ THIS[/b] 👀

The option to customise the menu will be only available in the [b]Career mode[/b] when you have [b]at least 5 recipes unlocked[/b]. If you've got 5+ recipes available, just finish the day and choose the CUSTOMIZABLE EXPERIENCE.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/e80906baa5d465463c1127e31a012c61b0eb9273.png[/img]


From now on, you'll be able to set up the menu between the days. Keep in mind that you'll need to include at least 5 dishes in the menu for each day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/5d92368963e71d11190c54c58368369c536b8c26.png[/img]


Additionally, there are numerous bug fixes, full changelog below 🐛

[b]General bug fixes[/b][list]
[*] Massive changes to code architecture and save system
[*] Reversing Y axis should work properly
[*] Setting mouse sensitivity no longer changes controller sensitivity
[*] Various translation fixes
[*] Intercom messages should properly display key binding icons
[*] Player should now be able to use checkout tablet after sending one dish when another just popped up
[*] Increased scroll speed in many lists
[*] Order icons displayed on TVs should no longer overlap
[*] Fixed some cases in which player would lose the ability to interact with the environment
[*] Player should now be able to turn off the timer when clicking the mark above it
[*] Changing FPS settings to every/second V blank actually applies the change
[*] Added or fixed various sound effects
[*] Various fixes to photo mode
[*]Text at the end of Food Network should be properly translated
[/list]
[b]Base game[/b]
[list]
[*] It's possible now to insert deep plate into microwave
[*] Microwave light is no longer turned on after loading a save
[*] Microwave should no longer heat up products that were pulled out of it
[*] Mint is no longer painting surfaces red
[*] Placing plates in microwave should no longer cause them to tilt and bug out
[*] Fixed issue causing fridge doors’ weird reactions when colliding with objects
[/list]
[b]Pizza[/b]
[list]
[*] Added missing Chinese characters
[*] Player should be able to properly progress in tutorial when using a gamepad
[*] Player should no longer be able to buy products when bankrupt
[*] Fixed bug causing player not to be able to properly navigate pizza decoration view while using gamepad
[*] Filling bemars while perk "Horn of Plenty" is enabled should work properly
[*] Destroyed furniture no longer duplicates after saving and loading
[*] Inserting large objects into grater machine should no longer cause them to bounce off of the lid
[*] Loading game no longer causes empty jars to fill up
[*] Dropped small objects on the floor in the basement should now be possible to pick up
[*] Decorating pizza should no longer cause product parts to jitter or land out of pizza
[*] Fixed issue causing scrolling of both decoration size and pinned recipe/order at the same time
[*] Reducing the amount of collision caused by interactions related to pizza peel
[*] Throwing all shopping boxes out of window now results in a new one spawning inside
[*] Pinning recipe in order details view is now binded to the correct key
[*] Added missing input hint for pad in order view in phone
[*] Player should now be able to scroll recipe when in pizza creation view
[*] Added two mops to the kitchen
[*] Fixed an error during pizza checkout
[*] Changed fuel deplate speed in various scenarios
[/list]
[b]Cakes and Cookies[/b]
[list]
[*] Loose products like flour should now create stains on the floor
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause bought items to never be delivered
[*] Info at the end of the day should now properly update
[*] Fixed bug causing toppings on cakes to be invisible
[*] Various optimizations
[*] Player should be able to remove custom made frostings
[/list]

We hope you're going to have tons of fun with the latest update! ❤️❤️❤️

Join our Discord and let us know how you like the changes:
discord.gg/bigcheesestudio

notes.title: Cooking Simulator Shelter coming soon!☢️
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/864dab7303f7b442f09b639f181400e18dc7e5ca.png[/img]

Hey Chefs!
We're constantly improving the game with various updates and new content. Check out this post to find out more about Shelter, a new expansion we've been working on!

[previewyoutube=UHVxU8mjpho;full][/previewyoutube]

Master the art of post-apocalyptic cooking in an underground shelter. Gather scarce resources, trade with other settlements and become the best food provider in the wasteland!

[b]Key features:[/b][list]
[*] An underground shelter in the middle of a barren wasteland.
[*] Post-apocalyptic recipes based on previously-unknown ingredients. 
[*] Hunt for mutant meat and grow glowing mushrooms and vegetables.
[*] A career mode with an immersive story. Make use of your resourcefulness and uncommon cooking skills to contact your long-lost family.
[*] Sandbox mode.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/612521c58a18f4cb2b8356a75ea533a5709907a9.png[/img]

[b]A culinary adventure in a post-apocalyptic world![/b]
After many years of wandering the wastelands looking for your long-lost family, you’ve arrived in an area known as Sector 12. You could use the nearby radio dish to contact them, but you won’t be able to fix it without the help of the locals. As the only skilled cook in the Sector, you’ll become the main food supplier for its inhabitants. Bake, cook, fry, and grill mutant meat, glowing mushrooms, and other post-nuclear ingredients. Find your family while bringing back hope and prosperity to the wastelands with your tasty and nutritious food!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/3dcc456c619f5598c51a9e675e12278c6b34a626.png[/img]

[b]An underground shelter: your new home.[/b]
The world after the apocalypse has turned into a desolate, barren wasteland with scarce resources and dangers lurking in every corner. The underground shelter you’ve come across will provide you with safety and a workspace needed to utilize your cooking skills. With a few adjustments, the underground chambers can be used to cook, store ingredients, and even grow radioactive plants! Luckily, the vault is hidden under an old shed which is a great spot for hunting nearby mutants and harvesting their meat. After all, in this cruel world, only the toughest and most resourceful cooks will survive!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/8d954c68413e395e83bb12affdb7722bc8bcf457.png[/img]

[b]Hero of the Wasteland![/b]
There are several settlements scattered across the area, and they could all benefit from the services of a skilled chef. Sell your food and exchange your resources thanks to trading caravans which travel across the whole Sector. Develop your post-nuclear menu and learn how to prepare the most desired foods with the limited resources you have. Do a few favors for your neighbors, complete a number of special orders, deliver enough food, and eventually, the other wastelanders will help you reach your family!


[b]Add the new expasnion to your Steam wishlist and don't miss any future updates![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1575660/Cooking_Simulator__Shelter

notes.title: Pizza Empire, a brand-new tycoon game coming soon!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/5191914740e64399912decda8fbf9e892e290cf7.png[/img]


Hi Chefs!
We're super excited to announce a new game we're working on! Pizza Empire is a tycoon in which you'll manage your own pizza chain while dealing with the mafia in a diverse living city. Sounds exciting? It sure does for us!

Before you'll check out the screenshots below and read more about the game's features, we just want to make one thing straight:
[b]Even though Big Cheese is expanding and there are many exciting things going on in the studio, Cooking Simulator is our #1 priority. We have a number of awesome updates scheduled for the upcoming future so stay tuned and don't miss out![/b]


[b]Pizza Empire[/b]
In this tycoon you’ll start by picking a spot for your pizza place, then hire some staff, contract suppliers and create your first menu. Understand your customers and deal with the mafia to expand. Soon your small pizzeria will grow into a true pizza empire spanning across the city.

[b]Key Features:[/b][list]
[*]Manage your own pizza chain
[*]Deal with the mafia
[*]Expand your pizza empire throughout a diverse living city
[*]Outsmart your competition[/list]
 
New York is the city of business, opportunity and of course pizza. What better place to build your Pizza Empire? But there is a catch. It’s the 90’s. No internet, no cell phones and mob operations are still thriving in the city. Plus the outfits are ridiculous. Can you handle it?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/ad95d06e9e97825773b40fa73c7c72a3db101b86.png[/img]
 
[b]The city[/b]
The city is divided into boroughs, each with different demography which translates into customers having different fancies, expectations and tastes. That makes expanding into new territory super exciting, almost as if starting a new restaurant from scratch.
Additionally city boroughs are built of city blocks. Each block has its own community and its own points of interest - places like museums, theatres, schools, factories, police stations and even mob hideouts. Explore the blocks to learn about the needs of communities and complete missions to win people's hearts.
Or you could not do that and instead ally yourself with one of the mobs, drive out the competition and leave the people no choice but to love your pizza. But be careful, when dealing with the mob, because it’s a slippery slope.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/1b824dc525fd14857587be1d7c185e0021936064.png[/img]

[b]The mafia[/b]
There are several mobs in the city, and they hate each other. Dealing with one will affect the others. You can accept their “friendship” and rise through the ranks, even help the mob to rule the entire city. Or you can stand up to them and deal with the consequences. Though I would advise to make friends with the police and hire some security.
Each mob has a native borough where its influence is the strongest, there are even blocks where you don’t stand a chance without the godfather's blessing. However most blocks remain neutral, with just some mob influence. Watch out for conflicted blocks, where different mobs are trying to gain power. Attempt diplomacy to wiggle your way out of the conflict  or play a dangerous game of switching sides.
Mobs also present opportunities, siding with a mob will open up new ways to affect your competition, like harassment, bomb threats or sabotaging their supplies. But everything comes at a price, the mob will require you to complete special tasks, anything from throwing a birthday party for Sonny to staging an assassination in one of your places. Just remember that the media and authorities won’t turn a blind eye to your shady dealings. That is unless you pay them off.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/f192f03a98070cfe12088d9fe23324022c4d6f85.png[/img]

[b]The pizza[/b]
However thrilling and enticing, the mob stories are just the background to running your pizza business. You won’t build an empire without expanding. It’s crucial to pick the best spots for your restaurants. Mob sympathies aside, restaurant placement affects the demography and the number of your customers, delivery range, and in turn influence over the borough and neighbouring blocks. You can even set up next to your competition to starve it out.
Next up is designing your new restaurant. Choose the furnishings that will best attract your customers. Of course the space available will affect your storage and guest capacity and overall satisfaction of both guests and staff. Be creative and remember that each of your pizzerias will be at least a little bit different.
Flexibility is the name of the game also when it comes to food. Create your own pizza recipes to conquer the hearts of different customers. Experiment with your menus and adjust to special events taking place in the neighbourhood. Be sure to keep an eye on the newsfeed to be always prepared and plan ahead to acquire game-winning supplies.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/d321b83c27c19ea2149d6255a314bf87599920e7.png[/img]

[b]The empire[/b]
But your empire isn’t just about opening restaurants. Securing the best (or the most cost-effective) ingredients and storing them is just as crucial. That means opening warehouses and managing deliveries. You will also need to set up delivery areas for your pizzas and in turn build up a fleet of delivery vehicles.
The staff also won’t manage itself, or will it? Laying out timetables for your employees, hiring new talents and laying off deadbeats might be fun at first, but as your empire grows and encompasses more and more restaurants, you will need help. Hire resourceful managers to take some load off your shoulders.
Every empire is built on conquest. And with conquest there’s conflict, and casualties are inevitable. Your competition needs to be taken care of. Of course, you could just make tastier pizza and provide more robust service, but you can’t count on your competition to keep things fair, now can you? Better hire some security, just to be on the safe side.
Or even better, go on the offensive! Plan aggressive advertising campaigns, discredit your competition in the media, undercut their supplies or just open up next to them and starve them out. And when things get hairy, you can always ask the Don a favor…


👑[b]Add Pizza Empire to your wishlist and stay updated![/b]:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1532790/Pizza_Empire

notes.title: B-17 Squadron coming soon!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/69bfffa99e7402d6f8fc56cc7432a0c4cca70021.png[/img]

Hi guys!
We're very excited to announce a new game we're working on. Check out the trailer and let us know what you think! 
We'll still be working on improving Cooking Simulator and creating new content for it, so stay tuned for future updates!

[previewyoutube=mt2U9U6XLmw;full][/previewyoutube]

Take control of a B-17 in a realistic bomber simulator. Destroy key targets by dropping tons of bombs on them.
Command each member of the crew and feel their stress and tension. Take part in the historical campaign across occupied Europe.

Key features:[list]
[*]Manage a B-17 crew.
[*]Take direct control over every squad member.
[*]Destroy targets.
[*]Fight enemies.
[*]Command an entire bomber squad.[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/241a227ea52669e812f3f39bc99d14fa29d96256.gif[/img]

[b]POWERFUL AIRCRAFT, STRONG CREW[/b]
Your plane is fully armed and has tons of cargo on board.
However, even the best-armed and equipped plane is nothing without the efficient crew to make up a successful team.
You will be able to sit at the controls as captain or co-pilot and control this powerful machine as well as manage the flight parameters, engine revs, flaps, etc.
In the radio operator's room, you can send and receive reports, study the map, and lead the squadron to its destination.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/5f9308dc2e1d0fedc32a61ba8d24447e9cf2d514.gif[/img]

[b]RETURN HOME[/b]
You dropped your bombs, didn't you? The target has been eliminated. 
But you're not done yet. To take part in another mission as a commander, you need to return the bomber and crew home. This might be difficult, especially if your machine has been damaged.
You will feel the tension as you watch the aircraft being damaged.
You know that if the plane is finished, so is the crew. However, remember that you have an engineer on the board, so try to be creative and use what you have at hand to solve any issues that arise.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/fd786c7889636f5c0168f42e6703dd6d4996e728.gif[/img]

[b]MANAGE THE PLANE[/b]
You will have to face more than the anti-aircraft missiles and Messerschmitt squadrons attacking the formation.
Your tasks will include keeping an eye on fuel, ammunition, and bombs.
At high altitudes, you must also pay attention to your oxygen supply. Make sure your crewmates remember to put on their masks.
Sometimes it will be necessary to sacrifice part of your cargo to have enough fuel to reach the airport.
You will have to deal with malfunctions such as a burning engine, broken wheels, a jammed bomb hatch, and others.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/b2bb81fd34e113aea9e5787ef43453fb497f4376.gif[/img]

[b]NOT A FIRST-CLASS FLIGHT[/b]
The flying fortress mission is not a first-class vacation flight. The living conditions of the crew will not be comfortable. There will be constant stress, adrenaline, and the struggle for survival.
Your weapons will help you survive the storms of anti-aircraft missiles and the attacks of enemy fighters.

Additional protection against the enemy will come from maintaining the proper combat box formation. Twelve bombers are posed to be the most difficult target for the enemy. You will be able to manage the entire wing to complete the mission.

Good luck, Captain!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/a7a39b97fba8ceb8eac0cb1a2d2ed6fe835c554f.gif[/img]

notes.title: Pizza available 12 November!🍕
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/06bcd5a7be4d2220fd4dd8a713bcb541b1ae451b.png[/img]


Hi Chefs!

We’re super excited to announce that Pizza, a new expansion for Cooking Simulator, will be [b]available next Thursday, November 12![/b]🍕 In this post we’d like to tell you a little bit about the awesome new features introduced with the expansion.

[b]New ingredients[/b]🌿
Obviously the core of Pizza is, well… making pizza. In order to give you some creative freedom, we’ve introduced over 130 realistic fresh ingredients. The list includes everything you might need for making delicious pizza. Different types of flour, meat, cheese, spices and herbs, liquids, fruit and vegetables, you name it!

The list includes:[list][*] 26 types of meat
[*] 13 kinds of cheese
[*] 36 fruits and vegetables (including pineapples!)🍍
[*] 22 liquids
[*] 26 herbs and spices
[*] 4 types of flour
[*] 10 additional ingredients, including chocolate, walnuts, yeast and more
[/list]

[b]Pizza[/b]
Each pizza consists of several components. The basis is the dough. You can choose between 4 predefined types of dough you can make ([b]Neapolitan, New York, Spelt Flour, Sourdough[/b]) and custom doughs made by trying out your own combinations of ingredients and proportions! Each pie is round and comes in 1 of 3 sizes: [b]large, medium or small[/b]. Every pizza needs some good sauce! There are [b]10 sauce recipes[/b] but just like with the doughs, there’s nothing there to stop you from coming up with your own tasty propositions. The next component is cheese. You can combine multiple types of cheese either grated or sliced. For the final touch you can use various types of toppings and herbs just to give your pizza that final touch! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/48abfa9b3fcae1276f13cf6dca875015b65be359.gif[/img]


[b]Customer orders[/b]📝
You can receive various orders for Pizza. There are [b]80 predefined orders[/b] with some variations, based on some of the most common pizza recipes, such as Margharita, Capricciosa, Quattro Fromaggi and so on! On top of that you can receive custom orders which require a randomly generated combination of components. Each pizza receives a rating based on the correct preparation of requested components: [b]Dough[/b] (size, kind, correct baking), [b]Sauce[/b] (kind, spread), [b]Cheese[/b] (kind, spread, correct baking), [b]Toppings[/b] (right kind, quantity, spread). If you’re playing Career mode, that game will also take into account the preparation time. Sandbox mode doesn’t include the preparation time in overall rating. 

[b]Italian Pizzeria[/b]👨‍🍳
Move to a brand-new, cozy Italian pizzeria consisting of [b]3 new working areas[/b]: a fully-stocked pantry, a prep kitchen, and an oven area. The new location looks stylish and has all the utensils and workspace you’ll need to master the art of crafting top-quality, authentic pizza!

The pantry located in the pizzeria’s basement is where you’ll find all the variety of ingredients. To expedite the collecting we’ve added large baskets for carrying multiple products.

In the prep room you’ll find all the machines needed for making the dough, preparing sauces, cutting and grating ingredients. After all the ingredients are ready, you can quickly move them to the final room using a special sliding shelf!

The last area contains a pizza assembling space and a huge wood-burning oven. Here you’ll roll the pizza pies, apply sauces, cheese and other ingredients and bake the pizzas. Once they’re ready, you can send them to your hungry customers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/6e60f5040415af13014830fa52b6cd97d2f95058.gif[/img]


[b]Smartphone[/b]📱
Since you liked the smartphone from Cakes and Cookies, we’ve decided to keep it in Pizza with some improvements. The smartphone will have 4 useful awesome-looking apps. Bella Pizza for browsing and managing customer orders, Questvilla used in Career mode for browsing quests, leveling up, progressing and unlocking new rewards, PerkHUB for using various perks and Pizza Pro containing all the important recipes. Unlike Cakes and Cookies, there will be no app for purchasing products as all of that will be done in the pantry.

[b]Career Mode[/b]🏆
In Career Mode you’ll be playing as a top apprentice taking over a well established italian pizzeria previously run by Papa Pepe. Papa Pepe is an old and experienced pizzaiolo who will be your guide and mentor. Make sure to turn on the tutorial on your first playthrough to get an introduction with a detailed explanation and various tips on how to run your pizzeria, prepare ingredients, heat the oven, make pizzas, manage orders, level up and unlock new products and recipes. Each day consists of two phases. Phase 1 starts at the beginning of each day and for its first 30 minutes you’ll be able to receive and accept pizza orders. Phase 1  lasts until you serve your last pizza, so you’ll always be able to complete all the orders you’ve accepted! Phase 2 starts after you complete your last order for that day and lasts for as long as you want to. During that time you can clean up your pizzeria, prepare more dough, sauces, ingredients and so on. Make sure to frequently check on the Questvilla app to complete various quests divided into 3 categories focused on either the quantity, quality or realisation time of your orders. Completing each category will result in unlocking the most powerful perks. Additionally, completing quests will allow you to unlock new recipes and ingredients to become an even better pizzaiolo! 

[b]Sandbox Mode[/b]⛱️
Sandbox mode is the relaxed, chilled out experience you all know so well from the base game. Get instant access to all the ingredients, perks and recipes and do whatever you want with the unlimited resources!


🍕🍕🍕🍕🍕
[b]Pizza will be available next Thursday on November 12. Add to your wishlist and don’t miss the release![/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1400460/Cooking_Simulator__Pizza/

notes.title: The best cooking games on PC in 2020
notes.notes:
What are the best cooking games on PC? If you want to relax and create mouth-watering masterpieces, or challenge your friends to some kitchen chaos, the wonderful world of cooking games and restaurant games doesn't disappoint.

You don't have to be a dab hand in the kitchen to work your way around these cooking games. If, like us, your dinner guests smile politely through a plate of charred chicken and accomplishing the perfection of a Gordon Ramsey special seems like a distant dream, then these games are a much more satisfying way to scratch that cooking itch.

The cooking game genre specifically focuses on restaurant management and whipping up recipes has taken a bit of a backseat since the release of Overcooked 2. Many management games and simulation games incorporate cooking as part of the experience, such as farming in Stardew Valley or setting the kitchen alight in the Sims. So, if you're after a more authentic cooking game then look no further as we've collated a list of the best cooking games on PC from time management to puzzlers.

notes.title: The best cooking games on PC in 2020
notes.notes:
What are the best cooking games on PC? If you want to relax and create mouth-watering masterpieces, or challenge your friends to some kitchen chaos, the wonderful world of cooking games and restaurant games doesn't disappoint.

You don't have to be a dab hand in the kitchen to work your way around these cooking games. If, like us, your dinner guests smile politely through a plate of charred chicken and accomplishing the perfection of a Gordon Ramsey special seems like a distant dream, then these games are a much more satisfying way to scratch that cooking itch.

The cooking game genre specifically focuses on restaurant management and whipping up recipes has taken a bit of a backseat since the release of Overcooked 2. Many management games and simulation games incorporate cooking as part of the experience, such as farming in Stardew Valley or setting the kitchen alight in the Sims. So, if you're after a more authentic cooking game then look no further as we've collated a list of the best cooking games on PC from time management to puzzlers.

notes.title: Cakes and Cookies - awesome new mechanics #2🧁
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/d8cfc8efbacbb07e6946e9f6146ff1c18fe4aff9.png[/img]


[b]Hi Chefs![/b]
From the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/641320/announcements/detail/2212900988812852786]previous post[/url] you already know everything about the process of baking and decorating your fancy customised desserts.🎂 This time we'd like to tell you a bit more about the brand-new rating system, which will allow you to sell and receive a score for virtually any pastry you make using a variety of ingredients and decorations.

Let's start the list of changes by introducing the smartphone, which replaces the laptop known from the base game.📱 The smartphone allows you to purchase utensils, cake pans and other supplies, browse recipes or take special orders. You can also use it to check on social media to see the trending hashtags, your confectionery popularity and to upload photos of your best desserts to receive some extra exposure. The smartphone can be accessed at any moment by pressing a single button, so checking on it doesn't break the flow of the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/7da7a8d411053e08d17e688f08eb27b13fe00255.gif[/img]


The best way to start each day is to check what are the 🏷️5 trending daily hashtags. Daily hashtags are randomly chosen from the following categories:[list][*] [b]Taste[/b] - related to the flavors (#Sweet, #Sour, #Fruity and so on)
[*] [b]Texture[/b] - related to the texture of the cake (#Crunchy, #Moist, #Fluffy, etc.)
[*] [b]Ingredient[/b] - based on the ingredients used in the cake (#Chocolate, #Cocoa, #Honey and many more)
[*] [b]Diet[/b] - they result from the certain combination of used ingredients or the lack of said ingredients (#Sugar-free, #Vegan, #Variety and so on)
Theme hashtags are also applied when you decide to follow a certain recipe, which will result in assigning tags like #Brownie, #Apple pie, #Cheesecake, etc. If you decide to create something unique, your creation will receive a #Homemade tag.
[*] [b]Special[/b] - tags assigned to desserts using certain decorations(for example #Birthday, #Wedding, #Halloween)
[/list]
Additionally, there are 2 hidden categories of hashtags, which cannot be drawn as daily hashtags:[list][*] [b]Complexity[/b] is used to determine the amount of work you've put in decorating the pastry. There are 5 degrees of complexity from #Simple all the way up to #Masterpiece. The more complex your cake is, the more positive reactions you'll get from selling it!
[*] [b]Shape[/b] tags depend on the type of cake pan you'll use. They don't affect the score but might be requested when accepting special orders. Example hashtags could be #Oval, #Star, #Heart and so on.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/e75c63f2445f828afcaea82129d273ed54cae206.gif[/img]


Daily hashtags help you plan your work for the day and determine what sort of desserts you’re going to make. The more daily hashtags you manage to include in your pastry, the higher are it's chances of being sold and receiving more positive reactions, resulting in increasing your confectionery popularity.
For example, if your daily hashtags are: [b]#Nut-free[/b], [b]#Animals[/b], [b]#Edible pearls[/b], [b]#Fruity[/b], [b]#Chocolate[/b], you could prepare a cake without using any nuts, inject some filling (preferably fruit or chocolate flavored!), add some edible pearls topping and decorate it using animal figurines, various fruits and even chocolate! 🍫🦊🍓

Of course, the more complex your cake is (determined by the number frostings/icings, whipped cream, toppings/dustings, fruits and figurines used), the more reactions it will receive. Cake containing 5/5 daily hashtags will have the highest potential to receive numerous positive reactions. Alternatively, you could prepare a number of less complex pastries containing only a few daily hashtags or even a dozen of donuts or cupcakes with just 1-2 suggested hashtags. There are many ways you can try to make your customers happy and it's up to you to find out which one works best for you!👨‍🍳

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/c103f36764c81ce42f3e4dcf86ce8b5d77e59565.gif[/img]


To break your daily routine, every once in a while your confectionery might have an opportunity to accept a special order! The more popular you get, the higher the chances for receiving such orders will be. Special orders will require you to prepare a specific cake in a given period of time. There are no penalties for declining such orders but completing them will result in a substantial popularity increase.
An example of such order could be a cake with the following requirements📝:[list][*] #Homemade cake
[*] Must include the following hashtags #Fit, #Gluten-free, #Cheesy, #Creamy, #Chocolate
[*] Square-shaped
[*] 2 layers: large and medium
[*] 2 different colours of frosting/icing
[*] Must be decorated with a Gingerbread Man figurine
[*] The level of complexity must be at least #Advanced
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/32f3e80802135f108ccbf8a08e0fde235c9de134.png[/img]


Whether or not you'll participate in any extra activities, by the end of each day you should place your pastries at the display, so they can be sold to the customers. The clients will purchase and rate your cakes and cookies depending on how well they match the daily trends and also how well they've been baked. Underbaked or burnt pastries will receive negative reactions (either a Sad or Angry face) and all the other sold pastries will receive 1 out of 4 positive reactions (Like, Wow, Haha and a Heart). Don't forget that you can also upload a photo of the day with your best cake to receive some extra reactions and further progress in the ranks of top confectioneries!🏆

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/d3c21642c24814e0e694aaf8ae1e62bce4c3513a.png[/img]


As you can see, Cakes and Cookies introduces a bunch of fun mechanics and unlocks new levels of almost unlimited creativity. The expansion will be available on May 28th. We can't wait to see you creating your own fancy desserts!🍰

[b]For those of you, who really can't wait to start their sweet adventures, we'll be running another developer stream on Steam this Friday at 6PM CEST. See you there![/b]

notes.title: Cakes and Cookies - awesome new mechanics #1🎂
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/ef61ee01a33578b3bb73b9b4f46c3464d0989c54.png[/img]


Hi Chefs!

You guys are showing great interest in the upcoming Cakes and Cookies expansion, so to give you more insight into the upcoming features, we’ll release a few more detailed posts.📝 This is the first one. This week, we’d like to tell you a little bit about the process of creating your very own pastries. In the next week’s post we’ll explain how the new tag system works and how it allows to bake and sell pretty much whatever you want without following any strict recipes.

Also, a quick reminder that [b]this Friday at 6PM CEST there will be a new developer livestream[/b] showcasing all the cool new features of the expansion. If you’d like to see how various cakes and cookies are being made in a professional confectionery, make sure you don’t miss it! The stream will be available on the game’s Steam store page. See you soon :)

The process of creating any pastry in Cakes and Cookies consists of 3 phases: preparing the dough, baking and decorating. At first you’ll need to decide what type of dough you want to make. Basically, you can choose between following an existing recipe or using the variety of new ingredients to create something your own. Recipe based doughs will receive categories such as brownie, cheesecake, etc. while your own creations will be tagged as homemade.🏷️
Now that you’ve decided on the type of dough, it is time to collect all the ingredients and put them into a bowl. Speaking of ingredients, there’s a ton of fresh stuff including a new category - loose products. That means things like different types of flour, biscuit crumbs, cocoa and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/82dfe9a2131c32a326f67d709b32a6c5ef4701b4.gif[/img]


Additionally, there are also new liquid and solid ingredients such as extracts and syrups, a few kinds of chocolate, baker’s yeast, cream cheese, eggs and butter, just to name a few. You should also know that it’s possible to melt some of that stuff!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/551688a75a7e96a5f70b07e5d34ba064cd27d198.gif[/img]


Once you got everything in one place it is time to choose between 3 different kneading tips, attach the bowl to the kneading machine, turn it on and let it do it’s magic. As a result you’ll receive either a solid dough or a liquid batter, depending on the bowl’s contents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/d04b56a0e57c234afa1bcb92199e556375c7e410.gif[/img]


There’s plenty of cake pans available, so the next step is choosing the one you like. Star-shaped, heart-shaped, square, oval, big or small, cake or cupcake and the list goes on! The batter is only good for larger creations such as cakes while the dough fits everywhere. Aside from the dough, some recipes might require preparing additional layers of filling, which are made using a kneading machine just like doughs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/b4dabaf9d1f88dd9738f9a0ce53d2ca578193d14.gif[/img]


After you’ve got your pan filled up, you should set the right time and temperature and slide it into the oven. Depending on your settings and the cake size, the results will vary from an unbaked cake through sad cake to a properly baked one, of course you can also burn your cake. Moreover, if you really try, you can have your cake burnt on the outside, while still raw on the inside! This will influence the final customers’ reactions (more on that in the next week's post).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/0349fb308b7f52a9ade4301aa4cc2de1afcc004c.gif[/img]


When your cake is fresh out of the oven it is time for the most fun part - decorating. There’s a certain flow to this that determines the order in which the actions can be performed. You can start off by stuffing the cake using a pastry pistol. There’s plenty of different fillings you can choose from. After adding that extra tasty punch to your cake it is time to take your confectionery spatula and apply some thick frosting or thinner icing. You can smear your cakes both on the top and on the sides, allowing you for some fancy colour combinations. There are many types of preset frosting and icings you can use but you can also use food dyes to create your own. Food dyes can be mixed together to generate even more colours. The idea of having all the colours of the rainbow at your disposal sounds pretty cool, right?🌈

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/777668488299e5ea8af449aa8a5818d7684f0a53.png[/img]


But wait, there’s more! After you’re done with all the smearing, you can stack up to 3 cakes on top of each other and turn them into a one that’s more massive and fancier. Now grab your scoop and add some topping or dusting. Once again, you can choose from a variety of ingredients like chopped nuts, raisins, jelly beans, cocoa, cinnamon, and many, many more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/15209a98ff498f7dda99949c0c7a0c3ce459e2ee.gif[/img]


One of the last steps is adding some cream on the top layer. The new tool allows you to do it manually, so you’ll be able to come up with your own patterns and drawings. Hopefully, you’ll keep it civil, guys :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/6572b74ceac76a2f3fa80553cd29d42f150ecd03.gif[/img]


The final touch is decorating the cake using fruits and figurines. There are some fruits available from the base game and there are some new ones as well. When it comes to figurines we’ve tried to include as many as possible: digits, animals, people, flowers, etc. 
They’ll also come in different colour variations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/5bfc89d5662ff27bd6ef48a2c043bfadc76bd9ed.png[/img]


And that’s it! Following these steps will allow you to prepare some amazing sweet desserts. Let us know, how you like those new ideas and what cakes are you going to make🧁🍰🍪

[b]If you’d like to see some baking in action, don’t forget about tomorrow’s livestream at 6PM CEST on the game’s Steam store page. [/b]

Happy cooking!







[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1227350/Cooking_Simulator__Cakes_and_Cookies/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/71b514cf4dfddd1cd91349b5588a1589ee9219d7.png[/img]
[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/4bad9cf7aa992dd54fc6606e87238937e6d965be.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/453cd189e297ba74925f3231e45a42da5990c501.png[/img]

notes.title: New patch available now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/1907a7ba571d6361163edb50c353279eb6011a5f.png[/img]

Hi Chefs!
There's a new patch available including a number of minor fixes that some of you guys have been asking for. Below's a full list:

[b]Fixed weird bugs related to the blowtorch[/b]
Many chefs have reported strange blowtorch behaviour. The thing couldn't be picked up and istead it started flying around the kitchen and disappearing into the unknown after a while. That was obviously not intended but you guys don't need to worry anymore. Those of you who can't resist playing with fire will notice that your favourite tool is back to normal!

[b]Increased the minimum resolution[/b]
We've already lost track of the number of people asking for help when they couldn't read any texts after their resolution was set to the lowest available. Since it's 2020, we've figured that nobody's going to play any game in such archaic resolutions as 640x480 anyway. The lowest settings have been bumped up a little so all the texts should be readable. If you still have some problems, please let us know!

[b]Smaller fixes:[/b][list][*] Fixes a number of minor errors causing breaking the input and making the game unplayable by not responding to controls
[*] SUPERHOT recipes will no longer appear in other game modes. That was obviously not intended.
[*] Locked out store items that have no use in current game mode. To save you guys some time and make buying more transparent, store will no longer display such items.
[/list]

Happy Cooking!

notes.title: Massive New Year's Bug Cleanup, part 1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/aaabc9ab9d7e1b6461b2a922b98509994e7cd0a2.png[/img]
This new patch contains a huge number of various bug fixes and gameplay improvements. Happy New Year, Chefs! Thank you for 2019, let's keep making the game even better in 2020. For a great start, the game's on -25% discount for the next 2 weeks.

[b]Psst! Want to know a secret? There's a new expansion on the way! More info next week :)[/b]

[h1]Full list of changes[/h1]
[b]General:[/b][list]
[*] Game loading time has been reduced
[*] Improved adding products into moving containers
[*] Improved collisions for Spring Onion
[*] Fixed the scroll indicator's position for the list of products in a container
[*] Improved achievement 'You missed a spot'
[*] Fixed the animations for trashcans
[*] Improved particle effects for pouring water in still containers
[*] Added missing hints for product spawners
[*] Added missing cursor icon for the cutting board and cutting products 
[*] Beer barrel can no longer be clicked on while pouring beer into beer mug
[*] Player can no longer gather Cooking Points after sending out an empty plate
[*] In-game screens will now have applied all the graphic effects in Photomode and endgame screen
[*] Hint 'Switch stacking' has been removed when highlighting an empty container
[*] All meat and fish products will now cut properly
[*] Improved performance for Steady Hands perk
[*] The timer sounds will no longer be played with muted audio
[*] Fixed an error that caused the fridge door to occasionally open in the wrong direction
[*] Fixed issues related to cutting T-Bone Steak
[*] Improved display of liquids in the Classic Food Processor container
[*] Pork Breakfast Sausage from now on will fry and grill on both sides
[*] Improved short circuit particle effects for damaged equipment
[*] Store can no longer be entered while sending out a dish and during the end of the day
[*] Fixed an issue that played  sounds for putting down objects after loading the game
[*] Increased scrolling speed for the store window
[/list]

[b]Leaderboards:[/b][list]
[*] Missing products have been added on the shelf
[*] The phase of choosing perks can now be skipped by changing a setting from the Main Menu
[*] Fixed incorrect display of some scores
[*] Extended feedback on technical issues in the dish score
[*] Fixed text displayed when exiting to Main Menu
[*] Recipe Pork Chops and Lemon Baked Potatoes - Oregano Twig spawns on the scene and is available in the shop
[*] Recipe Currant-Glazed Pork Tenderloin with Red Cabbage and Thyme Dumplings - Bavarian Recipe Beer Vinegar spawns on the scene
[*] Recipe Lemon Tart - Brown Sugar spawns on the scene
[*] Recipe Mango Tart - Brown Sugar spawns on the scene
[*] Recipe Spicy Sparkling Pork - Cola and Brown Sugar spawn of the scene
[*] Recipe Spicy Sparkling Pork with Spring Salad - Cola and Brown Sugar spawn on the scene
[*] Recipe Mango Salsa Chicken - Salsa spawns on the scene
[*] Recipe Mango Salsa Chicken with French Fries - Salsa spawns on the scene
[*] Recipe Chicken Tortellini Soup - Tortellini spawns on the scene
[*] Recipe Chicken Tortellini Soup with Croutons - Tortellini spawns on the scene
[*] Recipe Double Potato Salad with Pesto - Pesto spawns on the scene
[*] Recipe Chicken Tikka Masala - Fenugreek Leaves spawns on the scene
[*] Recipe Chicken Tikka Masala with Potatoes - Fenugreek Leaves spawns on the scene
[/list]

[b]Other game modes:[/b][list]
[*] FoodNetwork - fixed a bug that duplicated recipes from Food Network DLC
[*] FoodNetwork - improved appearance for cod stored in the fridge
[*] FoodNetwork - 'Exit' sign near the audience has been repositioned to not collide with the player
[*] Classic and Food Network - yellow sticky notes have been removed to increase the game's performance
[*] Classic - Serrano Pepper will now slide along with the fridge drawer
[*] Classic - added the missing outline for deep fryer during first day tutorial
[*] Classic - An outline for the wall clock has been removed
[*] Modern - All lanterns have working collisions
[*] Modern - Improved collisions for shelves in the pantry
[*] Modern - New Food Processor Container can now be bought in the store
[*] Christmas - Improved areas allowing for placing objects down
[*] Christmas - Improved performance for the summary screen
[*] Christmas - Microwave doors can now be damaged 
[*] Christmas - Microwave and griddle can be now repaired
[*] CookingSchool - Fridge door will remain closed during the 'Kitchen trip'
[/list]
And a number of minor fixes that didn't make it on the list :)

notes.title: Cooking Simulator Roadmap
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/9e8c833fe92fce768e54e8ef01f3984fd696ef1c.png[/img]

[b]Hi Chefs![/b]

The dev team is hard at work to constantly improve Cooking Simulator. Today we want to shed some light on things that we are up to and when to expect them. 

This is why we're very excited to present to you the [b]Cooking Simulator Roadmap[/b]. First in a [b]series of announcements[/b] spotlighting features and content currently [b]under development[/b]. It's also a way of letting you know [b]when to expect[/b] new content and important messages.

[b][h1]THE ROADMAP[/h1][/b]
Today's spotlight is on two major content updates coming to the game [b]for FREE[/b] in the next few weeks! But before you scroll down to learn the details, mark down [b]6th of December[/b] in your calendars. That's the date of our [b]next big announcement[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/d301f79a319eb5daadb483d5b75a23836501be66.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/b84c3c2ab6c92ad8139bb63207592222fe8c8f15.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/b3ffe625d34c948ef5c56b1c1836bfc24f9b844b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/800987c5c4d18bdac261b37a2e0b4c80fe9679a4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/ad0a0f5f1172dccaa3851dfe6eb494e0c85d4cfd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/ac9366b8771831f669fc21dfed7a4d0ff1d04b66.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/7c6a6ba8f64e91632ee0cb2741c660d8ce19406d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/181ce0c1ab797f8885dc429d638de0f02f1c5e67.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/48a042be162b9825b53ee8afdc37e4474f723ce0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/f1a2476932e712ca9ff053a7728652dba7b8e915.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/4d0235c0e14961e2f3f48116814b6f55f562c643.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/55e0a6c1e0642fb9987ad3936be30ba60216a546.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/24e7993de252da1cca41c52b50caa4458b72a6e5.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/f35a103522dae8d23ce85633240ca85e1efa2a4b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/784b1e1920ec93c4304d0b59fb996cdfce83d5a3.png[/img]

- What about features that aren't on the list? Does this mean you aren't working on anything else? - Rest assured, [b]we're exploring all kinds of different topics[/b] - from bugfixing, through optimisation, new content, new game modes to entirely new ways to experience Cooking Simulator. What we decide to share through the roadmap are features that we can put a specific timeframe on. [b]We don't want to tease you too much[/b] ;)

[b][h1]MODERN KITCHEN[/h1][/b]
Many of you have spent hours upon hours in Cooking Simulator's kitchen and [b]you need a change[/b] - we hear you! Staying in one place for too long can have it's toll. So on 21st of November we'll introduce a [b]new location[/b] to hang out and cook all that delicious food. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/78454547dabb5b0324d0da08d2b3514883e61cbc.jpg[/img]

Tired of the same old brick walls and all the noise coming from the streets? Try the [b]Modern Kitchen[/b] - a new fancy place located in a [b]luxury skyscraper[/b], detached from the racket of the city. Modern Kitchen will become available in career and sandbox modes (requires starting a new game) as [b]a FREE update[/b] to the game.

[b][h1]LEADERBOARD CHALLENGE[/h1][/b]
Ever wanted to prove that you are [b]the best chef around[/b]? Well, soon you will be able to! Pick an order from all the dishes available in the game and take to the kitchen. No distractions, just one simple goal - [b]serve the best dish you can[/b], the fastest you can. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29063568/adb7e7ceed4ef6a9f745123bc0919f996ad1618b.png[/img]

Based on this performance, the game will calculate your score and place you on a leaderboard. [b]Each recipe will have its own leaderboard[/b]. Become an expert in one or master them all. Rivalry begins on 4th of December with [b]a FREE update[/b] to the game.

[b][h1]SECRET ANNOUNCEMENT[/h1][/b]
But that's not all! We have another [b]very important announcement[/b] coming for you on December the 6th. Be sure to mark down that date and [b]visit our community page[/b] on Steam. We won't tease what we have in store for you - don't want to spoil the surprise, you'll have to be patient. But [b]feel free to speculate[/b] in comments, on the forums and on our Discord: https://discord.gg/cookingsimulator

Also be sure to let us know what you think about the upcoming features and this format of revealing them!

Hope you'll have a great time with the new content!
Cooking Simulator Dev Team
